summary: Tested DSE 890 Gateway UI fixes for sentinel value filtering, control button routing, and status LEDs. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working correctly - sentinel values filtered, control buttons responsive, status LEDs displayed.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 instead of 503 when MQTT client not connected. Error message is correct but status code should be 503 (Service Unavailable)

critical_code_review_comments: Backend _parse_gencomm_registers() valid() function correctly filters DSE sentinel values (2147483644, 32764, etc.) using abs(num-s)<0.5 comparison
Backend _parse_gencomm_registers() valid() function correctly filters values >1M as invalid
Backend _sanitize_telemetry() correctly filters historical telemetry values exceeding field-specific thresholds
Frontend sanitizeValue() correctly filters values >10M and field-specific thresholds
Frontend MetricBox component correctly shows '-' for null/undefined/invalid values
Backend send_generator_command() correctly looks up device for dev- generators to get dse_module_uid
Frontend sendCommand() correctly routes ALL commands through /api/mqtt/control/{id} (no frontend Pi/MQTT split)
DSE mode correctly read from telemetry and falls back to generator.last_dse_mode
Status LEDs (Motor laeuft, Auto-Modus) correctly displayed based on telemetry data
seed_data_creation: No new seed data - used existing generators and devices
context_for_next_testing_agent: DSE 890 Gateway UI fixes tested. Key findings: 1) Sentinel values (2147483644, 32764, etc.) are properly filtered in both backend and frontend. 2) Generator S50-18A01 (dev-72c3022f-3d51-4005-a21c-b09ec926fe97) shows valid telemetry: 120.5 kW, 50 Hz, 78.3°C, 80% tank, 13.6V battery, 231.2V L1, 1500 RPM. 3) Control buttons (Stop/Auto/Start) are clickable and route to /api/mqtt/control/{id}. 4) MQTT broker not connected in preview - control commands return 'MQTT client nicht verbunden' which is expected. 5) Device 07d42e9d has dse_module_uid='TESTUID123' for testing. 6) Status LEDs show 'Motor laeuft' (green) when engine running.
